0521Environmental sciences

Emissions Inventory

RenaissanceLabsEU/practice · emissions-inventory

Compile a greenhouse-gas inventory from activity records: unit conversion, emission factors, scopes, CO2e from several gases, trends and data cleaning.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • Unit conversion and table lookup before aggregation
  • Using supplied factors rather than remembered ones
  • Cleaning duplicated and missing records by a stated rule

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

A deterministic verifier compares each value in answer.json with the expected one; the reward is the weighted share of checks passed, and a missing answer scores 0.

How to run it

1. Get the tasksthis environment is one subset of the Practice dataset

hf download RenaissanceLabsEU/practice --repo-type dataset --include "tasks/emissions-inventory/*" --local-dir Practice
cd Practice

Leave out --include to fetch every environment and the generators.

2. Check one task by handbuild it, run the reference solution, run the verifier

docker build -t practice-task tasks/emissions-inventory/emissions-inventory-activity-data-d1-t0000/environment
docker run --rm --network none -v $PWD/tasks/emissions-inventory/emissions-inventory-activity-data-d1-t0000/tests:/tests:ro -v $PWD/tasks/emissions-inventory/emissions-inventory-activity-data-d1-t0000/solution:/solution:ro practice-task \
  bash -c 'bash /solution/solve.sh; bash /tests/test.sh; cat /logs/verifier/reward.txt'

Prints 1.0. Leave out bash /solution/solve.sh; to see the reward for doing nothing, which is 0.

3. Run it with an agenteach task folder is a Harbor task

harbor run --path tasks/emissions-inventory --agent oracle
# then your own agent and model, for example:
# harbor run --path tasks/emissions-inventory --agent terminus-2 --model <your-model>

The agent works in /app and writes /app/answer.json. The verifier writes the reward to /logs/verifier/reward.txt. Tasks tagged eval use seeds the train tasks never see.

4. Make more tasksthe generators are seeded and unlimited; needs the full download

python3 tools/export.py emissions_inventory

Needs Docker. The Harbor commands follow the framework's usual pattern and were not run by us; the Docker check above was.

Evidence

Every task: the reference solution scores 1.0 from the task files alone, an empty answer scores 0, and each check rejects a changed value.

Checked by our own test suite. No model has been trained on these tasks yet, so there is no evidence of training lift.
